provenance.title: Vocabulário na Língua Brasílica
provenance.dictionary_row_identity: entry_index and legacy_id are snapshot row locators, not permanent lexical IDs.
provenance.source_identity: source_line identifies a paragraph in this saved transcription, not a printed line number.
provenance.offset_convention: source_start0/source_end0 are a half-open interval in the unchanged UTF-8 decoded source text; all characters are BMP, so 1-based UTF-16 offset equals char offset + 1.
provenance.box_convention: OCR boxes are normalized [left,top,right,bottom] relative to original PDF page extent.
provenance.ocr_method: Monotonic normalized token alignment of the page transcription to OCR lines; boxes are approximate. Score is matched source-token fraction, not probability.
provenance.association_method: Navarro-to-source paragraph links marked proposed are retrieval candidates. Page citations and OCR spelling alignment do not themselves confirm lexical equivalence.
provenance.reviewed_association_scope: Only explicitly reviewed specific citation associations can carry reviewed status; no source paragraph is marked fully covered by these links.
